subject: Audit scope matrix & evidence transfer for SOC 2 Type II — Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC
messages:
From: Alex Moran <alex.moran@brightbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightBank Security Team <security@brightbank.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — scope and evidence transfer questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our InfoSec team is assembling the evidence pack for the upcoming vendor review and flagged a few scope clarifications we need before we proceed:

1) BrightBank requires the SOC 2 Type II report that covers the audit period Jan 1 — Mar 31, 2027. Can you confirm you can share the canonical PDF and any related bridge letter for customers using dedicated pools?

2) We run workloads in three ways with Redwood: Hosted (multi-tenant API), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), and VPC/private (customer-managed connectors). Our auditors want an explicit mapping: which deployment modes are included in the SOC 2 Type II, and if dedicated pools with burst-to-hosted behavior are considered in-scope or out-of-scope.

3) For evidence transfer, are you able to: (a) provide a control mapping spreadsheet (control -> artifact filename -> date range) and (b) a mechanism to exchange logs and attachments securely (SFTP/Box link/TSF)? We prefer an automated drop with short-lived links.

Also attaching our vendor intake checklist for reference. If you can respond today with the scope matrix and whether a bridge letter is available, that would keep our timeline on track.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moran
Vendor Risk Lead — BrightBank
security@brightbank.com

[attachment: brightbank_vendor_checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@brightbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — scope and evidence transfer questions

Alex —

Appreciate the checklist and the clear asks. Short answers up front, full details below:

• Canonical report: yes, we can share the SOC 2 Type II report for the audit period you requested (PDF).
• Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that explicitly addresses dedicated pools and hybrid/burst behavior — but we need a quick mapping from you on which BrightBank tenants are running in Dedicated vs VPC to tie to the bridge.
• Evidence transfer: we can provide a control mapping spreadsheet and two transfer options — (A) secure Box folder with short-lived (7d) links, or (B) SFTP with per-file PGP. We typically ship bulk artifacts via Box for external audits; logs over SFTP.

Details / open questions:
1) In-scope deployments: Our SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted API and all customer instances that run on our Dedicated reserved GPU pools that are part of the audited cluster topology under the 2027 report. It does NOT cover customer-managed on-prem VPC deployments where the network and connectors are customer-controlled unless you have purchased Redwood Private and requested inclusion in the Type II via the bridge process.

2) Burst behavior: Dedicated pools configured with "burst-to-hosted" are treated as mixed-mode for operational routing. For the audit, we enumerate those pools and include the control evidence for the reserved capacity portion. Any transient routing to hosted infrastructure is captured in the bridge letter language with mitigations (routing logs, fallback policies, and isolation controls).

3) Evidence artifacts: we will provide a control->artifact mapping (example: CC6.1 -> patch-management-report-202703.pdf). We can also supply a sampling of access logs (anonymized where necessary).

Next steps I need from you before we issue the bridge letter and Dropbox link: 
- Confirm which BrightBank tenant IDs are Dedicated vs VPC (tenant IDs or account names).
- Confirm preferred transfer method (Box link vs SFTP).
- Any additional controls your auditors will want full raw logs for (e.g., privileged-access sessions, KV-store audit traces).

I copied Karthik (security/compliance) and Kimberly (customer ops) to help assemble the matrix and run the evidence export. We can hand this off to an evidence pack run and provide a DocuSign request for the bridge letter approval.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security — Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — scope and evidence transfer questions

Marissa — thanks, that's helpful. Quick answers:

• Tenant mapping: BrightBank accounts are BB-PROD-01 (Dedicated), BB-ANALYTICS (Hosted), BB-DR (VPC). I can provide internal tenant IDs by EOD.
• Transfer: Box link preferred (short-lived) for documents; SFTP for raw logs >1GB.
• Auditor asks: they specifically want privileged-access session recordings for Dedicated hosts and a sample of KV cache purge logs for any Dedicated pools.

Can you also confirm retention window for exported logs (we generally ask for 90 days)?

If you can provide the matrix and the SOC 2 PDF + provisional bridge letter draft by COB tomorrow, we'll move to scheduling the audit review.

—Alex
Alex Moran
Vendor Risk Lead — BrightBank

Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — scope and evidence transfer questions

Alex —

Thanks for the tenant IDs; that's exactly what we need. Action plan and commitments below: 

1) Deliverables by 2027-05-24 COB (PST):
   - SOC 2 Type II PDF for Jan 1–Mar 31, 2027 (SOC2_TypeII_report_20240331.pdf)
   - Draft bridge letter addressing Dedicated pools and burst-to-hosted routing (DocuSign link to follow)
   - Control mapping spreadsheet (evidence-mapping-hosted-dedicated-vpc.xlsx) with artifact names and sample locations

2) Evidence handoff:
   - We'll provision a Box folder and upload the mapping + PDFs; links are 7-day expiry by default. For raw logs >1GB we'll provide an SFTP endpoint (credentials shared by Karthik to your ops mailbox).
   - Retention for exported logs in this handoff will be 90 days; we will provide a CSV sample of anonymized privileged session metadata and a separate encrypted bundle for full recordings if requested (not included in the standard pack — extra approval required).

3) Items requiring BrightBank confirmation:
   - Approve Box as primary transfer; SFTP only for >1GB artifacts.
   - Confirm whether auditors need full session recordings or only metadata samples (session start/end, operator id, action summary).

Karthik and Kimberly — can you prepare the mapping and schedule the Box upload? Karthik, I'll need the SFTP creds and expected ETA for log export (aim for 24 hrs).

I'll start the bridge letter draft and send the DocuSign once the tenant IDs are finalized.

Best,
Marissa

Head of Customer Security — Redwood Inference
